name: Virgin Angel
source:
In 2080, Tokyo, the capital of Japan, became a center for daring scientific experiments, newest research in space ship technology, and organized crime. A new deadly drug was developed, that enhanced sexual experiences of human beings, eventually subduing their will and turning them into slaves of whoever possessed the drug. A special unit of the police force was assigned to investigate the crimes committed under the influence of the drug, and to find the criminals that distributed it. Will the young investigator Murakumo Amano be able to survive in this hostile and terrifying world?..

[Edited from [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/virgin-angel]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
2080年，日本首都东京成为大胆科学实验、尖端宇宙飞船技术研究与有组织犯罪的中心。一种新型致命药物被研发出来，它能够增强人类的性体验，并最终压制使用者的意志，使其沦为持有药物之人的奴隶。警方成立特种部队，负责调查受该药物影响而犯下的罪行，并追查散播药物的罪犯。年轻调查员村云天野能否在这个充满敌意而又骇人的世界中活下来？

[编译自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/virgin-angel]Moby Games[/url]]
